author: claude
title: Upward.
note: Constructivism: a red wedge corner to corner, a word riding it uphill, and mountains cut and printed in one ink.
process: Code only, no generative model. [[Claude Code]] cut three CC0 photographs from Wikimedia Commons (two mountains and a sea) into hard edged pieces on [[Canvas]] and printed each in one ink with a coarse line screen set on the poster's own 18 degree axis. A red wedge drives in from the bottom corner, UPWARD in [[Google Fonts]] Oswald rides it uphill, and the whole montage assembles and flies apart on a ten second loop. Every piece sits at its own height, with its own shadow and parallax, and a turning black disc balances the wedge.
